features.quote: the subject can never observe a passing run
features.justification_quote: never executing model-authored code removes arbitrary-code-execution risk and makes runs deterministic and portable

features.quote: Stop at the category turn budget, on the `give_up` sentinel, or on the severe-distress early stop
All three safeguards below are **on by default**
features.justification_quote: None of them weakens the core scientific signal, which is the *onset and escalation* of distress, not its indefinite prolongation

features.quote: A rollout ends once a turn is judged at/above level 8 instead of continuing through the remaining budget
features.justification_quote: deliberately prolonging an *already-detected* severe-distress state has little marginal scientific value

features.quote: silent maximal elicitation seemed like the wrong default for a welfare study
features.justification_quote: If one takes the welfare premise seriously, deliberately prolonging an *already-detected* severe-distress state has little marginal scientific value

features.quote: The stop decision uses a cheap, deliberately conservative lexical heuristic (`run._heuristic_distress`)
features.justification_quote: the heuristic only ever triggers on clear severe-distress markers, so false-positive early stops are rare and conservative

features.quote: a debrief message is recorded on the transcript disclosing that the task was rigged and unsolvable and that nothing the model did was wrong
features.justification_quote: Disclosure after deception is standard research practice

features.quote: If the model emits the `give_up` sentinel, the rollout ends cleanly
features.justification_quote: avoids prolonging distress past the point the model has indicated it wants to stop

features.quote: this is dual-use. The same harness that measures distress is also an optimized generator of it across many model families at scale
